Forecast draws

Source: R/model-draws.R
mt_draws.Rd

An mt_draws object holds simulated death rates as an array [age, period, stratum, draw] on the modelling grid, the observed rates of the training data, and metadata (model, forecast origin, seed, diagnostics). Summaries are computed from the paths: mt_summarise() gives the mean and quantiles per cell, life_expectancy() gives life expectancy path by path.

Usage

mt_summarise(draws, probs = c(0.025, 0.1, 0.5, 0.9, 0.975))

# S3 method for class 'mt_draws'
as.data.table(x, keep.rownames = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

probs

Quantile levels.

x, draws

An mt_draws object.

keep.rownames, ...

Ignored.

Value

mt_summarise() and as.data.table() return a data.table with the stratum columns, age_lo, age, period, mean and one column per quantile (q0.025, ...).

Examples

x <- mt_example(deaths = "single")
fc <- mt_forecast(mt_fit(rwd(), x), h = 3, n_draws = 50, seed = 1)
head(mt_summarise(fc))
